result:
I added a **Resend Pending Invitations** operation to the Member resource of the Bitwarden node. I did not run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been run or type-checked.

- **Pending members:** It lists the organization's members and keeps those with status `0`, which is Bitwarden's "invited, not yet accepted" status.
- **Resend:** It sends `POST /public/members/{id}/reinvite` for each pending member.
- **Output:** It returns one item per member, as `{ email, success }`. If a resend fails, that member gets `success: false` and the loop continues with the next member. The error detail is dropped, so the output doesn't say why a resend failed.
- **No pending members:** It throws a `NodeOperationError` with the message "The organization has no members with a pending invitation."

The `status === 0` filter and the `/reinvite` endpoint come from my knowledge of the Bitwarden public API. I did not check them against the API docs, so please verify them before relying on this.

The operation runs once per input item, so several input items would each resend to every pending member. The no-pending error also stops the whole node, even with continue-on-fail set.

The changes are in `descriptions/MemberDescription.ts` (the new option) and `Bitwarden.node.ts` (the logic).
